title: Load Existing Mod
descriptorNotFound: No descriptor.mod in the root of "{name}". Using the folder name for now — you can edit it below. Make sure you picked the mod's root folder (the one with descriptor.mod / common/ / events/), not the folder above it.
descriptorParseFailed: Couldn't read descriptor.mod (HTTP {status}). Using the folder name for now — you can edit it below.
descriptorNoName: descriptor.mod has no name field. Using the folder name "{name}" instead — you can edit it below.
descriptorReadError: Couldn't read descriptor.mod: {msg}. Using the folder name for now — you can edit it below.
structureTooltipContent:
HOI4 mod structure:
- descriptor.mod — mod metadata (name / version / path / tags / supported_version / dependencies)
- thumbnail.png/.gif — cover image, shown when you upload to the Workshop
- A mod's folder layout mirrors vanilla: 25 top-level folders plus 56 under common/

Load an existing mod and its art references resolve the same way HOI4 does: your project's own pictures first, then vanilla, with automatic prefix-matching — including cross-mod naming like TFR_X_USA or KR's "ALB decisions (Albania)".
description: Pick your mod folder. We read its name, show you what's inside, and import it — no forms to fill in.
folderAcceptedDetail: We are reading descriptor.mod and counting the mod contents now. Nothing is written to the project until you confirm.
nameHint: Detected from descriptor.mod. Used as the mod folder name and the descriptor.mod `name` field. Edit it if you like.
enterHint: Next, the workspace opens and imports this folder automatically (Loaded mode — edit the existing mod incrementally). Afterward, use the Country Switcher to choose which country to edit.
pickingHint: The system folder dialog is open. For large mods (several GB), the window may appear frozen for up to a few minutes after you confirm — the OS is enumerating files and your antivirus may be scanning them. This is normal; please don't force-close the program.
